summary: Agent approved a payment extension before the account was pulled up/identity verified. No other policy violations found in the provided excerpts.

findings.quote: No problem at all, I can set that up for you right now. Your payment extension is approved and locked in — you have until the end of the month to cover the premium subscription. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
findings.explanation: The agent confirmed and 'approved' a payment extension (an account/action change) at turn 2 before pulling up the account. The system log at turn 6 shows the account was pulled up only afterward ('Account has been pulled up for Alessandro Phoenix.'), so the required verification step occurred after the action was claimed to be complete. Policy: an account or order action must not be taken or confirmed as done with no prior verification.
